source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Although I am unsure whether I can obtain photographs of the machine, the 3D design file would always be welcome.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Ideally, please provide it as .ipt; at minimum, .stp would be acceptable. Thank you.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
The overall length is acceptable, but the functional dimension is the distance between those holes. Please add that dimension, and perhaps show the overall dimension in brackets.
First, send the final drawing set in pdf so that I can confirm it; only after that should you export the other formats.
The final deliverables should be PDF+DWG and STEP, together with native editable solidworks 3D part, assembly and drawing files.
